name: Downhearted
overview: Scripture teaches that those who are downhearted, or burdened in spirit, are invited to find refuge and rest in God. The psalmist encourages believers to trust God continually and to pour out their hearts before Him, recognizing Him as a safe refuge. Jesus affirms that the poor in spirit are blessed and inherit the kingdom of heaven, offering hope to those who feel spiritually low. Furthermore, Christ extends a personal invitation to all who labor and are heavy laden, promising rest to the weary, highlighting God's compassionate care for the downhearted.
